title: Episode 243
source_name: AB Testing (formerly Modern Testing; Alan Page, Brent Jensen)
author: AB Testing
text: Hosts Alan Page (Spy) and Brent range across AI-assisted software development, the limits of automated testing, and how cascading failures happen in complex cloud systems. They then turn to voluntary retirement offers, financial certainty, purpose after work, and the challenge of making room for life beyond a demanding career.
